scripts.contracts:check: node --input-type=module -e "import Ajv2020 from 'ajv/dist/2020.js'; import fs from 'node:fs'; const ajv = new Ajv2020({strict:true,strictRequired:false,validateFormats:false}); const names=['request','response','event']; const fixtures={request:{protocolVersion:'1.0',messageType:'request',requestId:'req-1',type:'agent.run',payload:{}},response:{protocolVersion:'1.0',messageType:'response',requestId:'req-1',ok:true,data:{}},event:{protocolVersion:'1.0',messageType:'event',eventId:'evt-1',sessionId:'session-1',sequence:0,type:'agent.status',payload:{}}}; const validators={}; for (const name of names) { const schema=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../hybrid/contracts/schemas/'+name+'.schema.json','utf8')); validators[name]=ajv.compile(schema); if(!validators[name](fixtures[name])) throw new Error(name+' valid fixture rejected'); if(validators[name]({...fixtures[name],protocolVersion:'99.0'})) throw new Error(name+' accepted unsupported protocol version'); } const invalidResponse={...fixtures.response,error:{code:'ERR',message:'failure'}}; if(validators.response(invalidResponse)) throw new Error('response accepted both data and error'); const failedResponse={protocolVersion:'1.0',messageType:'response',requestId:'req-2',ok:false,error:{code:'ERR',message:'failure'}}; if(!validators.response(failedResponse)) throw new Error('response rejected valid error fixture'); console.log('Hybrid JSON Schema validation and compatibility fixtures passed');"
